completed_slice: Defined a fail-closed conjunctive adjudication contract for candidate origins of M-004, M-005, and M-006. A candidate must pass explicit assignment, namespace agreement, owner agreement, semantic-role agreement, temporal precedence, and immutable-locator integrity for the same object and referent; similarity, discovery order, or identifier reuse cannot compensate for a failed or unevaluated gate.
acceptance_remaining: Obtain an exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent repository history traversal.
Locate immutable candidate sources at or before each repository report boundary.
Evaluate each candidate against all six adjudication gates.
Inspect eligible privacy-reviewed decision logs, language lexicons, project documents, chat-history locators, and File Library documents.
Promote an origin only when one candidate passes every gate under documented coverage.

claims.observed: Existing queue and continuity artifacts require multiple independent provenance dimensions and explicitly reject temporal and namespace collisions.
claims.inferred: The dimensions must be conjunctive because each prevents a distinct false-positive class.
claims.proposed: Use one no-overwrite evidence packet per candidate and emit a result for every gate.
claims.superseded: A sufficiently strong match on some dimensions may compensate for missing provenance dimensions.
claims.unresolved: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain without a candidate proven across all six gates.

privacy_boundary: No private chat text, personal records, credentials, unreviewed File Library content, or raw sensitive excerpts were written.
safe_next_action: Traverse all accessible branches and pre-boundary commits, generate one retained candidate packet per qualifying source, evaluate the six gates fail-closed, and keep unresolved status wherever coverage or a gate is incomplete.
